answer: Clock-skew attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by profiling microscopic timing deviations in the quartz oscillator of each host during challenge handshakes. Instead of deploying a gale of virtual agents on shared infrastructure, an attacker must procure independent physical hardware to avoid duplicate drift signatures, triggering an unsustainable cost spiral per identity. A major limitation is that network jitter and temperature shifts can distort measurements, misclassifying honest nodes.
